transcript: Daddy, why did you hate my fries? I bought them and they were mine. But you ate them, yeah you ate my fries. And I cried, but you didn't see me cry. Daddy, do you even love me? Well, I wish you'd show it, cause I wouldn't know it. What kind of daddy is his daughter's fries? And doesn't look her in the eyes. Daddy, there were tears there. If you saw me, would you even care?
metadata_caption: Adventure Time - Daddy, why did you eat my fries (Marili Andre cover)
